archetypes.name: dyn-severity-alignment
archetypes.rationale: Severity math depends on fixed voter slot alignment across live tally and TSV ingestion.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed voter agreement row construction and severity distribution paths. Focus on whether three-slot voter severities stay aligned with votes in design, code-review, legacy, degraded, and MainAgent paths. Check that invalid, missing, NO, and uncertain severities flow into the intended buckets without changing decisions or point awards. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-calibration-reporting
archetypes.rationale: The voter-calibration report now adds a diagnostic severity table and threshold flag.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the voter-calibration analyzer and shell harness. Verify that panel and global severity sections mirror agreement rollups, the high-severity threshold is forwarded, and the diagnostic-only wording is consistent. Pay attention to bounded harness checks and whether the new output can regress silently. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
